title: Statistics And Research Methods In Extension
modules: Developing Hypothesis, Objectives And Identification Of
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the orderly procedure by which man increases his knowledge."
Research is the orderly procedure by which man increases his knowledge.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with data collection, organisation, analyses and interpretation of data collected for decision making."
Statistics is concerned with data collection, organisation, analyses and interpretation of data collected for decision making.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is described as skewed if the cases tend to pile up at one end of a curve and with a long tail at the other."
Distribution Shapes A distribution is described as skewed if the cases tend to pile up at one end of a curve and with a long tail at the other.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the mid point of a distribution."
The median is the mid point of a distribution.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a standard practice widely used in research surveys."
Pre-test is a standard practice widely used in research surveys.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ may be defined as the science of developing the capability of the people for sustainable improvement in their quality of life."
Extension may be defined as the science of developing the capability of the people for sustainable improvement in their quality of life.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to any aspect of behaviour or any condition that change."
Variables refer to any aspect of behaviour or any condition that change.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a detailed blueprint used to guide a research study towards its objectives."
Research design is a detailed blueprint used to guide a research study towards its objectives.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a characteristic of a sample, but a parameter is a characteristic of a population."
Statistic and Parameter A statistic is a characteristic of a sample, but a parameter is a characteristic of a population.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the average deviation of a distribution of scores from the mean."
The mean deviation is the average deviation of a distribution of scores from the mean.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an indication of the odds against the results of the study occurring by chance."
The probability value (p-value) is an indication of the odds against the results of the study occurring by chance.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a circular diagram in which each class or attribute is represented by a sector whose area is proportional to the percentage or relative frequency of the class or attribute."
Pie chart is a circular diagram in which each class or attribute is represented by a sector whose area is proportional to the percentage or relative frequency of the class or attribute.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a situation which exists as a generalised situation."
A problematic situation is a situation which exists as a generalised situation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a conjectural statement of the relation between two or more variables."
A hypothesis is a conjectural statement of the relation between two or more variables.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ may be defined as a selected number from a population to represent it."
Sample A sample may be defined as a selected number from a population to represent it.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a continuous assessment component of your course."
The TMA is a continuous assessment component of your course.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a process of change from the existing level to a planned new level."
Development is a process of change from the existing level to a planned new level.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a process of analysing, understanding, appreciating and consolidating the findings and project a meaningful and coherent view of the phenomenon studied."
Report writing is a process of analysing, understanding, appreciating and consolidating the findings and project a meaningful and coherent view of the phenomenon studied.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the first step in data collection."
Secondary data collection is the first step in data collection.
